widgetTool.name: show_csat_card
widgetTool.description: Shows a satisfaction rating card on chat at the end of the session. No spoken pacing is needed. Call shape: name is always cx-show-csat-card and all card fields go inside payload.

name.description: Always exactly cx-show-csat-card (the card element this tool renders).

payload.description: The card data. Put every card field inside this object.

textResponseConfig.textResponseInstruction: Ask the satisfaction question in one short sentence and invite a rating from one to five.
